url.description: Git URL (or local path) of the repo holding the marketplace/ folder

skills.description: Enabled skills, by folder name under marketplace/abilities/

tools.description: Enabled HTTP tool abilities (tool.toml), by folder name under marketplace/abilities/

mcp.description: Enabled MCP server abilities (mcp.toml), by folder name under marketplace/abilities/

personas.description: Enabled personas, by file name under marketplace/personas/ (default always loads)

disabledTools.description: Tools to leave out, by HTTP tool or MCP ability name; an MCP ability needs a `tools` list for this. The rest (and tools it gains later) stay on
